WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO DO?

Battleship is a two-player game where players attempt to sink each others fleet of ships.

 That is done by guessing their locations on a grid.
 Each player has a fleet of 5 ships and a 10x10 grid ,on which to place them.


The objective is to sink all of your opponent ships before they sink all of yours.


Start the Game:

 On pressing "Start Playing" button, the server will match you with another player.
 Drag your ships to the grid to place them.
 Changing ship orientation is achieved by clicking on it.


Rules for placing your ships:
 1.Ships can be placed horizontally or vertically but not diagonally.

 2.Ships are not allowed to overlap or be adjacent to each other.

 3.ships must not go off the edge of the board.

Playing the Game:

 1. Players attack by touching out a location the grid.
 2. If the location contains a ship, it is a hit.
 3. If the location does not contain a ship, it is a miss.
 4. The first player to sink all of their opponent ships wins.


you score higher if you sink your opponent ships in fewer moves.


 have fun playing the game!
